nodes.name: AdminOrderItemController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes admin-only order item endpoints for paginated listing, lookup by item id, and lookup by order id through the order item service.

nodes.name: AdminProductImageController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes admin product image endpoints for adding image URLs, uploading multipart image files, and deleting images for a product.

nodes.name: ProductImageController.java
nodes.summary: Provides the public product image endpoint that returns all images associated with a product.

nodes.name: OrderItemResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the serializable order item response projection and maps order item entities into API-safe response records.

nodes.name: ProductImageResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the serializable product image response projection and maps product image entities to id and image URL values.

nodes.name: ResourceNotFoundException.java
nodes.summary: Defines the shared runtime exception used when requested domain resources cannot be found.

nodes.name: OrderItem.java
nodes.summary: Models the order_items JPA entity with lazy links to an order and product variant plus purchase quantity and captured price.

nodes.name: ProductImage.java
nodes.summary: Models secondary product images as a JPA entity linked to products, with lifecycle hooks forcing image records to non-primary status.

nodes.name: OrderItemRepository.java
nodes.summary: Provides Spring Data JPA access to order items with entity graphs for eager order and product loading in list, lookup, and order-scoped queries.

nodes.name: ProductImageRepository.java
nodes.summary: Provides Spring Data JPA access to product image records, including lookup by owning product id.

nodes.name: OrderItemService.java
nodes.summary: Declares the order item service contract for paginated admin listing, single item lookup, and order-scoped lookup.

nodes.name: ProductImageService.java
nodes.summary: Declares the product image service contract for reading, adding URL-based images, uploading files, and deleting product images.

nodes.name: OrderItemServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements cached read-only order item queries, mapping repository results to order item response DTOs and raising not-found errors for missing ids.

nodes.name: ProductImageServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements product image reads and mutations with cache eviction, product validation, file storage integration, thumbnail assignment, and local-file cleanup on deletion.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring caching annotations with transactional service methods and a value-injected upload directory.
